using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Data;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForStringMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("vector", Mock.Of<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            stringMapper: null); // Explicitly pass null to trigger GetService call

        // Assert - Verify the factory was registered (GetService will be called during resolution)
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceFactory<VectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>, object>>("default");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForResultMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchResultMapper>(new MockResultMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("vector", Mock.Of<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            resultMapper: null); // Explicitly pass null to trigger GetService call

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceFactory<VectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>, object>>("default");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("vector", Mock.Of<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            options: null); // Explicitly pass null to trigger GetService call

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceFactory<VectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>, object>>("default");
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_ThrowsWhenVectorSearchMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
                vectorSearchServiceId: "missing-vector",
                textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding"));

        Assert.Contains("No IVectorizedSearch", ex.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_ThrowsWhenEmbeddingGenerationMissing()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("vector", Mock.Of<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>());

        // Act & Assert
        var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
                vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
                textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "missing-embedding"));

        Assert.Contains("No ITextEmbeddingGenerationService", ex.Message);
    }

    private class TestRecord { }

    private class MockStringMapper : ITextSearchStringMapper
    {
        public string MapToString(TestRecord record) => string.Empty;
    }

    private class MockResultMapper : ITextSearchResultMapper
    {
        public TextSearchResult MapToTextSearchResult(TestRecord record) => new(string.Empty, 0);
    }
}
